title: nbw-no-brand-2013-world-heavyweight
label: Derecho

won.source: The post of 12 May 2016 names Derecho 'the NEW NBW World Heavyweight Champion', after the eight-man qualifier announced on 26 January 2016.

lost.source: The post of 1 May 2017 names Warren Spade the new champion after 25 To Life.

how: Won the title in 2016, after an eight-man qualifier tournament for the vacant championship.
note: The date of the win is not in the held posts; Derecho defends at Scorched in May 2016 and loses it to Warren Spade in April 2017.

title: nbw-no-brand-2013-world-heavyweight
label: Warren Spade

won.source: The post of 1 May 2017 names Warren Spade 'the now NBW World Heavyweight Champion' after 25 To Life, which the 28 April 2017 post announces for that night.

lost.source: The post of 17 August 2017 says the title changed hands 'two weeks ago' when Jake Tockwell defeated Warren Spade.

how: Won the title from Derecho at the 25 To Life pay-per-view in Singapore.
note: The result is stated in the reporter's post of 1 May 2017 and in SLAM 91's announcement of 12 May.

title: nbw-no-brand-2013-world-heavyweight
label: Jake Tockwell

won.source: The post of 17 August 2017 says the title changed hands 'two weeks ago' when Jake Tockwell defeated Warren Spade.

lost.source: The post of 22 December 2017 names Brock Newbludd the NBW World Heavyweight Champion after the 7 December post's rematch for Tockwell.

how: Defeated Warren Spade for the title.
note: Held to a rematch with Brock Newbludd announced on 7 December 2017; by 22 December Newbludd is the World Champion.

title: nbw-no-brand-2013-keystone
label: Max Hopper

won.source: The post of 12 May 2017 says that at 25 To Life 'we also saw the Keystone Championship change hands when Max Hopper became its guardian'.

how: Won the Keystone Championship at 25 To Life.
note: The post of 22 September 2017 says a new Keystone Champion was crowned the week before; the held posts do not name him.

title: nbw-no-brand-2013-keystone
label: Rey de los Diamantes

won.source: The post of 12 July 2019 says he won the title from Alex Reyn; the posts of 10 and 26 June 2019 name him the Keystone Champion.

lost.source: The web exclusive of 12 July 2019 says the Keystone Championship 'has been vacated'.

how: Won the Keystone Championship from Alex Reyn.
note: The title was vacated on 12 July 2019 because of a shoulder and arm injury.

title: nbw-no-brand-2013-blitzkrieg
label: Ohiyama

won.source: The post of 8 August 2017 calls him 'Blitzkrieg Champion Ohiyama', defending against Rune.

how: Held the Blitzkrieg Championship from the summer of 2017.
note: The posts of 8 August to 25 October 2017 name him Blitzkrieg Champion; the win itself is not in the held posts.

title: nbw-no-brand-2013-blitzkrieg
label: Big Rick Strongbern

won.source: The post of 28 September 2018 calls the Blitzkrieg Champion 'new champion Big Rick Strongbern'.

how: Won the Blitzkrieg Championship in September 2018, after VIP's reign.
note: He defended it against The Great Wall in Tijuana on 27 January 2019.

title: nbw-no-brand-2013-blitzkrieg
label: Jonny Bedlam

won.source: The post of 20 March 2019 says 'the Blitzkrieg title is defended by new champion, Jonny Bedlam'.

how: Won the Blitzkrieg Championship in March 2019.
note: By 27 May 2019 he also holds the World Heavyweight Championship challenge in a title-versus-title match.

title: nbw-no-brand-2013-infamy
label: Benjamin Jones

won.source: The post of 28 September 2014 names Benjamin 'KO' Jones the Infamy Champion.

note: The post of 21 November 2014 has him defending the Infamy Championship and his newly won Blitzkrieg Championship.
